status: Isolated wrapper variant built and linked from the exact installed revision. Review patch, source archive, manifest and valid FSELF are available; no installed kit admission or deployment performed.

installed_observation.title: FAKE78003
installed_observation.descriptor_reason: The file exists with mode0600; the current read-only WFM download returns404. No permissions were changed.
installed_observation.lifecycle: PS5 terminates Wine11 during the native big-app handoff. A fresh Wine11 process is required after the game exits.

existing_contract.normal_per_game_exit: Report the session, close it, close publication, then sceSystemServiceLoadExec(exit,NULL).
existing_contract.generic_mode_restart: Only restarts that native title's own catalog; it is not an arbitrary title return.

proposed_contract.descriptor_changes: None. Keep game-launch.json byte-identical and exit_policy=exit-title.
proposed_contract.home_screen_launch: No argument, therefore existing exit-to-Home behavior.
proposed_contract.legacy_playden_launch: Existing session argument alone, therefore existing exit-to-Home behavior.
proposed_contract.wine11_launch: Add the exact opt-in argument only after independently verified wrapper capability admission.
proposed_contract.normal_exit: Only after a game reached running and session reporting succeeded: close session/publication, make one fixed-target PS5 title-launch request, then let the system complete handoff.
proposed_contract.failure: No retry/relaunch loop. Fall back to existing leave_to_home on startup/session/launch failure.
proposed_contract.not_supported: Native process faults, forced PS5 Close Game, power loss and process kill bypass normal atexit logic. Wine supplies no game exit status here, so a Windows game failure that exits Wine normally can also trigger an opted-in return. No watcher or daemon is introduced.

procedure: Build an isolated variant from the installed wrapper's exact source revision, preserving original source and artifacts.
Extend only per-game argument parsing and normal-exit routing; keep descriptor parsing, publication admission and session reporting intact.
Preload/link the already used PS5 title-launch/user APIs and use the validated32-byte launch ABI. Avoid runtime symbol lookup at atexit.
Record the opt-in capability and new wrapper/provenance/file digests in a newly verified kit variant.
Use the existing same-artifact title refresh and ownership checks with the native title confirmed stopped. Do not raw-upload an eboot behind stale owner/kit digests.
Acquire a qualified exclusive publication/control lease before the activity recheck and hold it through the refresh. RefreshTitle itself is not a standalone coordinator or lease acquisition API.
Require the unchanged runtime/recipe artifact set and unchanged game/settings publication. Refuse any path that would regenerate profiles or upgrade game data as a side effect.
Update only Wine11's caller to send the new opt-in argument after the new wrapper capability is verified.

ownership_preconditions: Resolve(record) must admit the verified kit, managed title identity and canonical owned paths.
Runtime and recipe artifacts must match the existing record by exact artifact_id, identity and sha256, with the same count.
Title directory must be a nonsymlink directory; the private game/bottle directory tree must pass the existing ownership and mode checks.
Both existing title/template owner markers must be readable, name the same install/title and carry the same valid old files_sha256.

RespinIdentity must match for both markers. The admitted exceptions cover file-inventory digest, runtime revision/path and variant_id; install_id, title_id, compatible kit_id, runtime_bundle_id, template_path and recipe identity stay bound.
New files are copied through temporary files, synced and digest-verified before both owner markers advance. Partial updates must retain the existing retry/recovery semantics.
The general RunPrepare path is broader than this operation and can call EnsureWritable and settings publication. Do not invoke it blindly for a wrapper-only change.
Snapshot and verify byte-identical descriptor/profile/committed-publication files and original game-data/config/save hashes around any future title refresh.
preserved_files: Quake executable, assets, PAK files, configurations, saves and existing bottle/profile contents
expected_control_metadata_changes_on_fut: Native title eboot/build provenance and verified kit file inventory
Existing title and bottle owner marker inventory digests, as required by the supported title refresh

validation.complete_wrapper_build_and_link: passed in isolated source checkout; see evidence/game-return-build.json

remaining_risks: Calling platform launch during Wine's exit handler must be verified on hardware; portable tests cannot prove acceptance or timing.
An accepted launch request may still fail asynchronously. Exact waiting/fallback timing needs platform verification.
Target absence, disabled jailbreak or provider initialization failure must retain a clean Home fallback.
The installed kit's exact refresh compatibility and ownership records must be admitted before any future replacement; these private records were not read during this task.
Adding a new exit_policy or blindly sending the new argument to the current wrapper would break validation and is not proposed.
This is a new Wine11 process, not a resumed Windows desktop process. Restoring the prior library/window state requires separate Wine11-owned state handling.

Direct PS5Home launches are unchanged by the argument parser when the platform supplies no launch argument. Hardware validation must confirm the platform does not replay a previous launch's opt-in arguments.
